status: DRAFT for owner review, not wired into the app

rules.where: set result screen (practice, PYQ, custom, mistakes, bookmarks, deck sets) after at least 5 answered questions; lesson finish card if the owner says yes
rules.once: at most one line per app session (in-memory flag, sessionStorage as a backup in try/catch)
rules.pick: subject of the set (module id -> subject via PREP.subjectOfModule); mixed-subject sets and mocks use the branch list
rules.rotate: store.ml[subjectId] counter, next line each time, wraps; synced with the store
rules.never: emoji, em-dash, AI or source labels, exam result promises, claims about this set's result, other people, fear or guilt
